scope: Synthetic unit-model reducer decision verification only. No browser, Docker, application replay, network, authentication, installation or upload. No product-source edits.
tablePolicy: Enumerate every dependency-valid subset by bit-mask membership and direct prerequisite check; fix original full subset to failure and enumerate all Boolean values for other closed subsets. A table true produces frozen Alpha observation; false produces frozen Beta observation. No actual browser behavior is inferred.
neighborReference: For each final selected unit, breadth-first traverse reverse dependency adjacency to remove that unit and all present dependents. Deduplicate resulting subsets. Never call production without() or copy its ordered forward-pass algorithm.
ordering: Each process runs chain-noise tables 0..63, star tables 0..255, then controls in frozen listed order. Formats source, emitted, installed each run twice in separate sequential processes.
comparison: Compare complete reduction results, full model run evidence and reference audit after deleting only keys startedAt/durationMs and replacing the exact owned per-process artifact root with <OWNED_ARTIFACT_ROOT>. Case-level process metadata is retained separately and not part of the semantic transcript. IDs, reasons, observations, manifests, identities, event order and execution counts must match.
identity: Preflight hash every frozen source file from prior emission manifest, every prior emitted input, and every installed package inventory member; compare before import and after execution. Model harnessDigest is SHA256 of verifier worker bytes, explicitly separate from actual source/emitted/installed harness identities.
acceptance: Every actual candidate is a subset of the frozen original, dependency-valid and frozen; its assertion, fixture and execution identity remain exact.
Every invocation receives a unique owned execution artifact path and a fresh model reset marker.
Every accepted trial contains exactly two conclusive target failures with matching identities.
Final best preserves table failure; all final BFS dependency-group neighbors are oracle-nonfailing and actually tested after final acceptance before a 1-minimal claim is accepted.
Enumerate global smallest failures and retain all larger-than-global outcomes without calling them errors or claiming global minimality.

Known inconclusive, unstable, identity-mismatch, cancellation, deadline and incomplete-budget cases cannot accept incomplete repetitions. For satisfaction-first alternation, report early rejection and any resulting minimality label under the product policy separately from stronger unestablished repeated-neighbor stability.
All six per-case semantic transcripts match; failures and exceptions are retained without selective rerun.
retention: Each process writes append-only raw case NDJSON, summary and command receipt. Every case retains run evidence, trial ledger, final manifest and exhaustive-reference audit. Preserve every outcome including validation failures.
controlSemantics: Alternating failure-then-satisfaction and satisfaction-then-failure are both scheduled per candidate. Record actual invocations and unobserved scheduled follow-up. The product criterion requires two failures for acceptance; a first satisfied observation may reject after one run. Do not assume symmetric stability guarantees or call that explicit policy a defect. Flag any stronger final-neighbor stability claim as unsupported when follow-up was not executed.
revisionReason: Parent review sets each outer process to existing 120-second and 2-MiB combined stdout/stderr bounds; declare separate raw evidence size cap.
sizePolicy: Fail and stop the current process before raw evidence would exceed its cap; preserve every completed raw record and report any partially completed/unrun cases. Never silently truncate raw JSON evidence.
